title: InventoryReserved
description: Topic: inventory.reserved. Producer: inventory. Consumer(s): orders, payments. Published after a successful (all-or-nothing) ReserveStock call — see contracts/proto/inventory.proto and ADR 0007. No customerId: inventory has no customer concept, by design.

items.description: The reserved quantities, echoed back so payments/orders don't need to call back to orders just to know what was reserved (no shared DB — see ADR 0004).
